text:
nidhi: proposal: introduce a tiny preflight admission handshake to unify backpressure signals across gateway + edge. goal: predictable hints for SDKs and safe handling for streaming vs unary.

aj: what fields do we return? keep headers small.

nidhi: draft headers: X-Edge-Admission: v=1;action=allow|queue|reject;wait_ms=NN;bucket=ID and optionally X-Admission-Token when queued. For streaming, initial control frame ADMIT:queue:wait=NN.

sarah: telemetry note: emit admit_action and wait_ms histograms, differentiate preflight vs inline admission. dashboards need to show per-tenant rates.

ken: server-state vs stateless: two options. store short-lived accept-records in-pop keyed by token (TTL 2m) OR use signed token (HMAC) encoding admit-id+expiry to avoid storage. signed token reduces storage but requires key rotation discipline.

maria: for side-effect safety we must default to conservative: if request has mutable side-effects and no idempotency key, prefer reject or slow-path rather than queue+token. SDKs should surface strong warnings.

aj: streaming caveat: queueing holds streams open and consumes connection resources (HTTP/2). rule: only queue if wait_ms <= 100ms for streams, otherwise reject with Retry-After.

ken: implementation detail: token format suggestion: base64(hmac_v1|admit_id|expiry_ms). Keep token size <= 128 bytes. We'll prototype.

sarah: rollout plan: 1) observe-only headers, 2) SDK preflight plumbing, 3) per-tenant enable, 4) pop canary, 5) global. set alert thresholds for preauth_fail_rate and queued_to_allow_ratio.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy: admission-preflight to 5% POPs at 04:00 UTC.

nidhi: I'll draft RFC with config schema and sample SDK code snippets. please comment within 48h.
